name: User Service - Null Pointer Exception
description: TypeError occurs when trying to access properties on undefined objects (e.g., user.settings.theme.darkMode or user.address.zipCode).

name: Payment Gateway - Boundary & Off-by-One Error
description: Tiered discount calculation fails on exact threshold values ($1,000) and fee array indexing accesses out-of-bound element returning NaN.

name: Data Processor - Async Flow & Unhandled Promises
description: Batch user data fetching uses Array.prototype.forEach with async callback without awaiting promises, causing early empty return.

name: Auth Middleware - Inverted Token Expiry & Loose Checking
description: JWT expiration condition is inverted (validating expired tokens instead of active ones) and role authorization uses incorrect comparison.

name: API Router - Exception Handling & Status Code
description: Custom error middleware catches validation errors but omits setting response status codes and fails to format JSON error payload.
